items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Stecklet Interview, 1959-06-15
items.q: Fisher, do you remember hearing him? No.

ctx.x: No, I never did. Did you hear his thing? He used to have a lot of scrubs you understand, play with him. I never did see where he had a real band you understand that you could say was everybody played they pause. But he, a noisy fella you see. He used to get the bag, get jobs. He oft times asked me to play but I told him I'm engaged.

Do you remember uh Fisher's band? It was a band run by I think it was Johnny Fisher. Do you remember, I think that was uptown, that might have been in the Irish channel up that way. Maybe so. Fisher, do you remember hearing him? No. Did you ever know any of the Brunus family? Brunus.
Brunus. Up there in the Irish channel? Yeah. Well they, they had a band I believe of Brunus.
